figures.finding: Full age in Guernsey is eighteen under the Law Reform (Age of Majority and Guardianship of Minors) (Guernsey) Law, 1978, s. 1; a person under it is a minor, and the Children (Guernsey and Alderney) Law 2008 also defines a child as under eighteen.

value.law: Law Reform (Age of Majority and Guardianship of Minors) (Guernsey) Law, 1978, ss. 1 and 3; Children (Guernsey and Alderney) Law, 2008, s. 122

figures.applies: Guernsey (the 1978 Law is Guernsey's; Alderney has its own Age of Majority Law, 2001, and Sark is not covered here). Secondary: the statute's page on guernseylegalresources.gg sits behind a bot check.
figures.webSearch: 2026-11-01: (1) 'Guernsey "Age of Majority" law eighteen guernseylegalresources': returned the NCMEC questionnaire answered by Carey Olsen (Guernsey) LLP, October 2025 (read: the 1978 Law, s. 1, full age 18, with its guernseylegalresources.gg document link), Jersey's 1999 law (not Guernsey's), Bailiwick Express on a child-marriage ban. (2) 'Guernsey employment of children rules age 13 ...; Guernsey child performance licence entertainment': only Jersey and UK pages. guernseylegalresources.gg still serves a Cloudflare challenge (not passed).

sources.said: The Law Reform (Age of Majority and Guardianship of Minors) (Guernsey) Law, 1978 provides that persons under "full age" (being the age of 18, under section 1 thereof) may be described as minors

figures.finding: A minor cannot be appointed a director of a Guernsey company under the Companies (Guernsey) Law, 2008, so a director must be of full age, eighteen; nothing read sets an age for holding shares.

value.directorNote: the Companies Law bars minors; full age is 18 (1978 Law, s. 1)

figures.applies: Every Guernsey company. Secondary: the Companies Law's text on guernseylegalresources.gg sits behind a bot check.
figures.webSearch: 2026-11-01: (1) '"Companies (Guernsey) Law, 2008" director minimum age "16" OR "eighteen" disqualification minor director Guernsey': returned Mourant's guide on directors' duties (read, saved), Interlegal and Mondaq overviews (a director must not be a minor), expanship.com (says 18; commercial guide, not used), Walkers, Appleby, Ogier, GFSC and the Guernsey Registry's directors page (read: registration rules, no age). (2) 'Guernsey "Age of Majority" law ...': full age is 18 (above).

sources.said: The Companies Law imposes eligibility requirements: a minor or a person who has been disqualified as a director anywhere in the world cannot be appointed as a director of a Guernsey company.
